items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. TLS reports no certificates expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is not established. Exact decision: retain private launch gates; allow only bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing authorized read-only security evidence matrix only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. No new proposal, change request, requeue, deployment, dependency, credential access, permission change, telemetry expansion, or external outreach is authorized.
